blocks.text: The hotel table adds up to 26 nights, while the heading states 25. Hotel Real La Merced is listed for two nights, although days 15–16 show one night in Granada. The two consecutive one-night entries for Palacio Maya correspond to the days in Mérida and Cancún, with no explanation. Confirm the hotels and the exact allocation of nights before booking.

The accommodation package line says “+ flights”, but international and domestic flights are listed as exclusions. Until this is confirmed, arrange airfare pricing separately. Flights shown in the itinerary do not mean the tickets are included in the tour price.

The scheduled excursions are led by an English-speaking guide. Transfers, accommodation with breakfast and admission tickets as specified in the itinerary are included. Optional excursions are paid for separately.

The National Palace in Mexico City can be visited only when it is open to visitors, and access to the terraces of León Cathedral is subject to availability. The Yucatán cenote, hot springs, canopy tour operator and waterfall on the Chagres River are unnamed and will be confirmed when you book.

Visiting the Green Turtle Museum in Tortuguero is optional. Check the price and availability in advance. Views of the volcanoes from the El Tigre viewpoint depend on the weather. The itinerary does not include visits to those volcanoes.

Pacaya involves an ascent from 1,900 to 2,300 m. At El Tigre, expect about three hours of moderate to more demanding walking, followed by about 35 minutes on horseback. Consider whether these more active sections suit you when choosing your itinerary.

The itinerary mentions a light snack at El Tigre and a traditional lunch in Tusípono. Lunch is mentioned before the walk through Tortuguero village, but the lodge meal plan is unspecified. Other meals and drinks that are not listed are paid for separately.

Sightings of quetzals and other wildlife are not guaranteed. On day 3, you visit Teotihuacán first and then the Basilica of Guadalupe. The timing of the walk in Mérida depends on the flight and is arranged separately.
